text: Loved this place. Deep dish cornmeal crust was unique in a good way. Cubano pizza was so strange and yet amazing- pickles and mustard on pizza! There tomato sauce was the umami bomb. Greek salad awesome. Service great. Conveniently located near Embassy Suites and Convention Center Metrolink. Fun foodie area.

My partner and I decided to eat from Saffron Patch from Grubhub right before they closed for the night. We had never heard of this place before but we were craving Indian food! We ordered their Butter Chicken and Chicken Tikka Masala both of which were good. The portions for the amount we paid for, however were not worth it because the portions were small for a relatively expensive dinner. Overall Saffron Patch was a tasty choice for late night Indian food but was not worth what we paid for.

Had a huge lunch and the Feast was the way too go. We are two big fellas and took home enough for another dinner or two. This is NOT a BBQ joint that has to hide the meet in sauce,  it stands on it's own and smoked just right. Awesome flavor. The sauces are great and my favorites were the sweet and mustard, are pretty good. The Mustard is off the chain with the smoked sausage. Burnt Ends, Brisket, Chicken, Ribs, Turkey, huge bbq beef ribs... you can be certain to leave full. I totally recommend this BBQ joint as one of my best.

So I have eaten hear 4 times in the last two half weeks.  The service has always been fantastic (Lindsey is the only severs name I remember). We have had a lot of items off the menu and everything has been great.  I am so glad that they have opened on the West side of Carmel as I have been visiting the Hamilton Town Center location. I will probably be back one night this week!

This place is delicious.  Great vegan options,  definitely order the vegetable samosa,  and hot and sour soup.   We also had bhindi masala and aloo ghobi,  both good.   Order directly from restaurant, save on grub hub fees for pickup.

Everything we ordered was mediocre. Noodles were not fresh. The lady at the front didn't want to be bothered with taking an order or answering questions, even though the place was completely empty. Asking for extra napkins after we were given 2 napkins for a table of 4  was apparently the straw that broke the camel's back...she got real irritated. Even if the food were better, I would never go back.

If I lived in Philly... I would be a regular. First and foremost the service was great. When going to most African restaurants, I usually turn a blind eye to the quality of the service, for the taste of the food! But with Kings & Queens Liberian Cuisine I didn't have to do that at all.

I started off with a great ginger juice to open my palette, and had the fried tilapia fish with "country" dry rice as my main- Yes, yes and yes! There was hot fried pepper on the side, so I could add to my  tolerance level! 

I will definitely be back, to try more items on the menu! My friend had the cassava leaves and said it was great- I'm a huge fan of torborgee, so that'll also be a must-try for next time!

Very mediocre food and really poor customer service. Our orders got messed up, were not corrected, and were met with a poor attitude from our server. Pictured is the eggplant Parmesan Po' boy. Very dry and bland, but ordered this as this was the only vegetarian option on the menu.
Great food and very clean. Best quick $10 lunch I've had in a while. A few seats inside. Salsa bar is

This is a must have while in NOLA. They never disappoint me. I look forward to a new slider option or breakfast item every time I'm here. The coffee is so yummy it pairs well with any flavor donut. The service here is always a pleasant experience. They have several options around the city and one in Baton Rouge that I know of. So when you go to New Orleans check them out.

I think some of the reviews are harsh for this restaurant especially during pandemic. This restaurant has ok prices since you pay for convenience and there's double work on management and staff, making sure people stay safe and healthy. The food is comparable as outside restaurants. 

There was a wait when we came this morning. First you fall in line to get to the waitlist, which was about 5 mins for us. Then we were told there will be 30 mins for table to be ready, yet we got called in in just 15 mins. Got service a few mins for drinks then a few mins as well for our orders. The wait for the food was ok too. We got steak and eggs, and korean bulgogi bowl. Both were ok or expected. I like that the veggies on my bowl were properly cooked, still crunchy, and both steaks on our orders were tender.

Four stars is for overall experience, which is what is expected from a similar restaurant. The service was good. Our server was great and the manager (maybe) also checked us. The only reason it's missing a star is that, while I enjoyed my bulgogi bowl, I think it would be better if they enhance it with more korean bulgogi flavor.

Trying this for the first time, my daughter wanted authentic Mexican food . They gave us chips and an assortment of salsa that was tasty and homemade. The waitress was attentive and pleasant. When the food arrived it was presented neatly and the prices were fair. I'm glad we stopped here.

Calamari chewy and a bit over breaded comes with marinara  and tarter. Wouldn't order it again. 

Oysters fresh and tasty like the ocean comes with 4 sauces.

Prime rib sliders delicous red wine reduction onions and horseradish sauce and au jus.

Matthew server said the wine would be super balanced and it was. He was an excellent server. 

Hibiscus Manhattan edible hibiscus flower.

Erick servers helper kept water filled. 

Seaweed on the tuna tacos super crispy rice flower or wonton shell horseradish cream. 

Broccolini mushroom pizza chefs selection. Good what from red pepper flakes could us maybe a little finishing salt.

Shrimp tacos were super tasty. Well seasoned. 

Thy have taken out tables and all are 6 ft apart they are wearing gloves 

Lloyd chard perfect balance of butter and oak.

Saw the disenfrcting tables and seats between seatings.

Call at 3 to make a reservation for happy hour at 4.

Our office ordered multiple meals due to some many people hyping it up how gr8 the food was.  Well let me tell you!, maybe the ambience of dining in gets them high ratings but the food lscked flavor and taste. The entire office was pissef bc we wasted money.  Long of the short, DON'T BELIEVE THE HYPE.
Jorge was awesome and accommodating! He made amazing drinks and we couldn't be more happy with the experience. Highly recommend!

OMG! Those cho-cho's....oooooh, those cho-chos, they will never, ever, ever, ever, (one more time), ever disappoint. 

I just placed an order for two cho-chos and baby let me tell ya, they are still as good as they were pre-COVID.  

Those cho-chos are like, "COVID won't stop me from tasting good, humph!"  Ha,ha,ha,ha! 
 
Seriously, China Doll has some of the most amazing and authentic Chinese food on the Westbank and I'll definitely support them because they take pride in producing delicious food. 

If you haven't had a cho cho from here, you're missing out!  Stop by and try one.

Health fare? Come get it.

Portion control? You got it.

Fresh ingredients? Always. 

They cater. They do dine-in. 

This place helped me drop over 100 pounds.
On the expensive side but worth it if you're vegan and love Mexican food! One of the best vegetarian food places in town.

So, first of all, I have been there twice, and have had 2 different experiences.  The first time was very good - both the venue and the food.  The word must have gotten out, and the second time we went (July 2019) the place was packed.  And...that is what this review is about.

The music was great.  If you have not been, they have song-writers who sing their own music.  Some of it is largely unknown, but some has been recorded by major artists.  That part was great both times.

They cram the tables together, and the place was jam-packed.  The service was the opposite of good - with drink and food orders taking fuh-ever to get out there.  And, the food was not great either.  My wife had a chicken something-or-other that she said tasted good.  I had the brisket sandwich.  It was tough and cut into slabs.  There were ribbons of fat or gristle running through it.  It was relatively tasteless, even though it was advertised as a special rub and smoked until tender, blah, blah, blah.  You will see you waiter to take you order, and then when they want to be paid.

I sent a comment in to the Listening Room through their website.  They never responded.  It's a business.  I get that.  Like an airline, they are going to cram as many paying customers in as they can.  My personal opinion (and it pains me to say it) is that they grew until they broke.  

Nevertheless, the music was good.  Next time I will order a hamburger or something simple for them.

Omg! Not only was this a delicious meal, but from beginning to end a wonderful experience! Anything on the menu can be made gluten free or vegan! They even have an entire vegan menu. We had the Tom yum soup with spicy coconut milk broth, drunken vegan noodles, veggie spring rolls & sticky mango rice with mango! Our wonderful waitress Noy (sorry if I spelled that wrong) she was amazinggggg and suggested butterfly tea which is now our new favorite tea! It's a gorgeous blue tea that turns purple when you add lemon. Immediately my new favorite restaurant - I cannot say enough great things about them and their food!

Great Coolinary offering and overall atmosphere! Highly recommended, but be sure to make a reservation! We had a group of 5, so most of the items on the Coolinary menu were sampled and all were equally as tasty!

My wife and I were on a celebration getaway to New Orleans, and we wanted one splurge dinner. 
We love Italian, so after reading the reviews, decided to give Vincent's a try. 
Parking is a challenge to say the least. 
They are said to have a lot, but we didn't find one. We were lucky to get a spot on the street though. 
We walked in, and were immediately greeted by the friendliest manager we have ever met. His name is Tony, and calls everyone "Baby" and "My Love" it's not quite creepy, but almost, as it catches you off guard. 
The rest of the staff is very attentive as well. 
The bread and drinks were brought almost immediately. The bread was simple and good.
Most entrees come with a soup and salad. The salad is a fancy spinach and arugula mix. Their house vinaigrette was good. 
I got the soup, which was Italian Chicken Vegetable. It had a great flavor that was complex. 
For our entrees, my wife got the Chicken Parmesan, which was good, but not spectacular. At over $18, was a bit overpriced for what it was. 
I got the Cannelloni, which had a mix of veal and cheese. It was really tasty. 
Now a word about the bathrooms. 
They were tiny! You couldn't literally be sitting down, and wash your hands without moving. 
The restaurant is in a very old building, so it's not surprising. 
That said, no one goes to a restaurant for the bathroom. 
In conclusion, Vincent's was a good splurge dinner, but I don't see us returning, as we are simple people when it comes to food. .

An authentic Italian bistro that's a hidden gem in Tampa.

I did take out for Valentine's Day. Their phone line kept ringing busy so I decided to check if it was open and sure enough it was! It's a cute small restaurant that has about 7 tables got 2, catering to couples or intimate gatherings with a close friend! Their food was awesome and the owner himself is from Italy so I had high expectations! The pasta was delicious but was slightly overcooked for one of the dishes but it was so flavourful that I didn't care too much! The menu is small so I'm
Sure that helps make sure the dishes are made with great quality.

Price was very fair for the quality of food you get. Not overly expensive for the quality of food you get. Each dessert was $7 while the chicken carbonera was $16, osso bucco was $26 and the ravioli was $23. All well worth the price! 

Beef Ravioli- my favourite dish of the night! This was not on the menu, but it was one of the dishes of the day! I'm so glad I chose this because it had a beautifully rich red sauce that had wonderful seasonings, herbs, mushrooms and drizzled with truffle oil on it! The ravioli was cooked perfectly Al Dente and the filling was soft and delicious. 5/5

Chicken Carbonara- the spaghetti was cooked Al Dente and had wonderful flavours all around. The bacon was wonderful and the cream sauce did not drench the pasta so that it cheapened it. It really made you appreciate it. The Parmesan was a wonderful touch and prominent in the dish! This w

Best Thai restaurant in the area. I've been to the best Thai restaurants from San Francisco to Tampa Bay and this little jewel is right up there when it comes to taste and authenticity. Please stay around because Largo can't afford to lose you.
Do you like tasteless chicken piccata, brown lettuce, and paying for missing garlic bread?  If so, this place is for you!

Just what I have been looking for, a cool place for Sunday breakfast. Coffee was great and food was awesome. Used waitlist on yelp worked great.  Wish it was closer to my house though. Need to open another one further south.

Omg this place went downhill BIG TIME!!!!!!!! This used to be one of my favorite places to eat and now I don't know what happened to this please. Gross, soggy , and cold food every single time. I'm done with this place

My wife and I took our grand daughter here for a celebration and were very impressed with the service as well as the food.  I'm not much for Sushi, but this was delicious.  Our server (I believe his name is San) was an incredible waiter.  He kept the food and drink coming and was social without invading our conversations.  He was kind and polite.  Not used to that kind of service any more.  It made for a great dining experience.  
      This is definitely a place I'd highly recommend and will go back to.  I think I'm a Sushi fan now.

We always enjoy our meals at Byrne.  We are treated like family when we arrive. This past visit we ordered:
25 buffalo wings- these are the best wings that fall off the bone ; we also requested Ranch dressing and celery. 
1 Large plain pizza. 2 orders of regular logs which come with sour cream and cheese whiz. Mussels in red sauce, which came with bread and butter. 
The service is fast. Most of the waitress know us and  the owner too 
There is a bar at this restaurant. The restaurant is not that big. Sometimes you will be sitting right next to other customers.  You will be able to hear each others conversations. 
The table are not that big. When our order came we had to compact our dishes on top of each other so our food could be placed on the table. But that is half the fun. 
My only compliant is the women's bathroom. It is what it is! Very Very small. The bathroom has a toilet set and a sink. The only way to go to the bathroom is to sit on the side or Hover on the side of the bathroom.  It is well stocked but again very small. When you do sit everything is close to you, turn to the right ,sink to the face, turn to the left toilet paper to the face. 
Besides that, we will continue to visit Byrne

Fantastic service from the moment we arrived to the time we left. Food was delicious as well. Burger tasted great and was prepared perfectly. Osso Buco fell off the bone--so flavorful and tender. Lots of interesting and unique paired flavors in a classy atmosphere made this a dinner to remember.  I can't wait to return next time I'm in town!

Stopped by here on my lunch break the other day and ordered a slice of tomato pie. It was a huge end piece (my favorite) which had an airy dough crust which toasted up in the oven crispy before they served it. The sauce had so much flavor, and was a tad sweet. This is my new favorite tomato pie!!
Very helpful staff and great food. I really like the wings and there margaritas are really good as well.
This place has the best chinese food around West Chester. Highly recommend the General Tso's chicken.

Incredible food. Do you like Italian food? Looking for the best sandwiches around? You found your place.

I just finished their porchetta sandwich . Sarcone's bread, broccoli rabe, and sharp provolone along with a pile of their homemade porchetta. Almost 2 pounds (860 grams). 

Get your butt in here. 
(Pun Intended)
No seafood (and no seafood) in the main  dining room?!?! Used to love Salmon over pasta in a blush sauce specials. This will seriously reduce my number of visits.
I've been here many times over the years with my husband. Always great! We had Lawrence as our server tonight. He was absolutely wonderful and we had a good meal as always
They have a great selection of beers and they also have very good burgers.  Great place to hang out with some friends.

There are some places on earth that shouldn't exist but somehow they do.  New Orleans itself probably shouldn't as it is fighting a losing battle with nature.  But nestled inside the neighborhood is another place that should not exist, but does.  I'm talking about a place run by fk-boiiii's and girls.  That somehow turned throwaway middle school brown bag lunch items and made them into adult brown bag lunch items and made them insanely great.  Don't take my word for how incredible this place is, it is, just get down here you farging stoner and have a fried bologna sandich and rejoice in the absurdity of this place, this city, and this life.
The Ambiance is amazing here. Full vegan menu! Not pricey. Many options. Not vegan fast-food

Clean & "hip" for the most part, I love the vibe of this place! The food on the other hand, specifically anything with chicken, just horrible. The chicken tastes so fake and is so chewy, it's plain gross. I can only tolerate so much before I have to stop. Not real Mexican food either but that should be a no brainer.

Tried the Shrimp Po-Boy and it was the best of the 3 I have tried.  Bread was very soft.
The oysters were very flavorful.
The s'mores cake was rich and sweet.
Service was good.

Such darling, sweet ladies at this little restaurant. We had never had a raspado, and there weren't any other customers when we arrived, so they thoughtfully explained the various combinations and even gave us a small sample of their Mangonada. What a burst of flavors! 

I loved the Mangonada, and my husband had the one made with pineapples and coconut. He was smiling the entire time he ate it.

We live in Marana and just wish this was closer to our house. Hope they have wonderful success. We'll be back!

I might've come on an off day, but I got the al pastor burrito. It tasted very sour and it was from the veggies. Another person I was with got a bean and cheese burrito and said it tasted sour as well. I'm not sure if it was too much lime mixing with something else or if the food went bad. I'll try it again at some point, but this is the current review for it.

The lady on the phone (over phone order) was very nice and the employees there were also friendly.

Pretty good. Great portions for lower prices than the other taquerias around town. I had the carne asada quesadilla with a side of rice . I am overjoyed for the little things like purchasing Mexican rice as a side is a option. Also, the fact that they keep all the extra ingredients on the side and not stuffed in the quesadilla to make it soggy . The meat was tender and flavorful. The pico de Gallo was most definitely freshly made.

Got an order of the Madame crepe and a classic strawberry crepe. Found both good but disappointing. Both lacked appropriate filling. The proportions were off. The Madame crepe was thin and only had a slice of ham. I was expecting it to be filled with stuffing for the price. The classic strawberry crepe was 80% whipped cream. By the end it was just soggy chocolate bread. Side sausage was fantastic, and well proportioned. Very unlikely to return.

Love this place.  My Familia goes here at least once a month for breakfast...well, before Covid anyhoo.  The nicest people work there too.  Breaky is always Dew-Lish!
It's a charming little joint with cookie jars everywhere.   If your lazy AF as my family and don't like cooking breakfast then get your fat arses down there.

We had a great steam pot meal on a Saturday night. The Creole sauce made hot was excellent. I was glad that I had a reservation because otherwise there was over an hour wait. The restaurant is small, but our table was ready as soon as we arrived.

This place was great! They had a 99 health score and they were insanely nice. I had a good conversation with the gentleman behind the counter and my whole experience was great.

I had the Philly cheese steak and took a cheese burger to go. The fries were simple but delicious and the sandwich/burger were so stinking good. 

I will be back.

This gem is perfect for healthy on the go or even a quick retreat within the city!

The food is healthy, fresh, and eventful. Concept is similar to a chipotle where you pick and assemble, but these guys do it better than other variations.

The portion is  generous so you're not leaving this place hungry! It's also well packed so it's easy to take on the go. 

The inside is fresh with  plants and a enviromental sustainable theme. 


Everything about this place made me feel good about eating here. Even the employees are courteous and on rope of their game.

Consistently good food! However, due to their fear of Covid, they are closed to indoor dining and only doing takeout. Their phone system is atrocious, service at the counter is mediocre to bad. . Wish there was another choice on the east side of Tucson.

The food here was excellent. I would definitely recommend the brussel sprout salad as it is enough to feed one person. It was so good. I had the chicken curry which was also delightful. The servers and shop are super nice and it's a great bang for your buck.   I will definitely come back here again

Great food and a good price!
I laughed at the bad review -- it was some dingbat who was all bent out of shape over some nonsense and nothing related to the food.

I do love their late hours so that I can come in on those late nights for a bite. I put 3 stars because I think their food is very average. Gets the job done but I wouldn't say anything here is extraordinary or amazing. If it wasn't for their late hours, I probably would go here less frequently.
The burritos are huge. You never leave here hungry. The tacos are also good and meats are very tasty.

This place is SO CUTE. They are only opened at certain times, but, overall a great experience. The food is so good, and the s'mores you get that you can make at your table are cute and delicious. Love this place in the summer.

Ordered the following:
Shrimp = Perfect
Gizzards = Perfect
Livers = Perfect
Cole slaw = Perfect
Mashed taters = Perfect
Diet Coke (2lt) = Ice cold.

These people continue to win my heart!
Great food. Clean and bright. I had the special,  fried Catfish on top of grits and 2 eggs  over easy. Perfect.

If you want to come here, make sure you have a reservation, dress appropriately, and get a loan lol. The ambiance here is really great. Reminds me of restaurants in Vegas or NYC. So that I really liked, but the food wasn't impressive. The best part of the meal was the wagyu dumplings, which were one of our appetizers. We also go the mussels which were standard. Nothing out of the ordinary. For our entre, I got the 12oz filet and my hubs got the trio meat special that came with wagyu, elk and something else that wasn't that great. The elk was yummy as well as the wagyu. Dessert we got the cinnamon roll but really I feel like they took a Cinnabon and just added walnuts. Nothing special here. Now, we did get drinks; Chardonnay of course for me-- which wasn't fantastic and my hubs got a Cabernet and an old fashion. With tip the check was over $300!!! I'm not sure what's the deal with that, but I wasn't expecting it to be that much. I don't mind paying, for delicious food, but this place missed the mark for sure. Don't know how I feel about going back. We only went here because we're fairly new in town and didn't know how fast Bern's reservations get filled.

After my  reservations at Atttco were canceled (due to the city being under curfew), I had to find another restuarant to celebrate my birthday.  Walking past Del Frisco's Grille, my boyfriend and I decided to give it a try.  We walked in around 530p on Friday and was able to be seated right away.  The restuarant is large, so we  were able to have a section to ourselves. Our waiter ( I believe his name was Anthony) was outgoing, funny, and informative.  He answred all our questions pertaining to the menu and drinks.  I would say their steak eggrolls  are the best things on the menu! Hands Down!  Unfortunately, they only give 2 cut in half. I wish it was atleast 3 lol.  We were not rushed during our meal, and was able to dine at our leasure.

Great service. Food is okay depending on what you order. Pad Thai was not very good- too much sauce and too sweet but the curry was amazing! The green tea ice cream had a weird texture to it. Overall, I can't give it less than 4 stars because the service was great and some of the food items are much better than others.
Love this place. Employees are so friendly. Clean atmosphere. Delicious toppings! Especially the spicy Mayo and eel sauce. We eat here often

I love Mexican Seafood so this place was a must to try. First impression was that it was small, hidden, closed (tinted windows- it was not closed), smelled clean, and an awesome no wait! Parking was zero problem as this location is in a shopping plaza.

The waiter suggested a booth for us, and we asked to sit elsewhere and they were happy to let us pick.

Free salsa and chips as an app, it is super flavorful and pretty spicy(if you are not a fan of spicy). So good. A portion of my party was in fact not a fan of spicy, so we also ordered the queso(not free) and it was amazing. Still flavorful and not too spicy. Highly recommend.

I ordered the Patas de cangrejo (crab legs) and I personally asked if I could have this spicy and a regular Michelada! Amazing crab legs. (2 clusters for 19.95)

Note: Sweet tea is bottled Gold Peak (we were expecting some good in house sweet tea) and was not notified verbally or on menu.

My only complaint is that I had to swat and "shoo fly" gnats... one actually landed on a piece of my food which was a big turn off.

Was disappointed when I sat down for dinner and wasn't greeted with or offered chips and salsa. Huge sigh. A server never greeted me. I sat there for 20 minutes and finally had to get up and order at a counter. I was very disappointed with the lack of taco options as my go to is normally tacos de lengua. They didn't  offer ceviche or even a northern or southern style mole. Another huge sigh. Overall the baja blast was ok, would make for a fine mixer for a fun cocktail. Settled for a beefy fritos burrito but the fritos were stale. If it wasn't  for the caramel apple empenãda that saved this disaster of a dinner, I would have easily given 1 star. Next time I'll call ahead on trying a new Mexican restaurant I haven't been to.

Forget Chinatown. Excellent, clean and fresh. Mustard Greens has been our go-to place, serving the most deftly prepared high quality Chinese ,  for consistently fresh and reasonably priced weekday meals or a place to bring out-of-town guests.  The best steamed dumplings anywhere.   Vegans and vegetarians will not be disappointed with any veggie dish. Other favorites are their incredible string beans, crab fried rice, nectarine chicken, pork and curry noodles, fish -- anything!  Lovely casual atmosphere, and the service is impeccable.  GO!
Fresh hot beignets with a sweet tea that was super sweet! Super messy but worth every bite!

I love these guys, the food is great.  The hot and sour soup is different from what I normally find at Chinese restaurants which is a welcome change of pace.  Portions are just right and the pricing is great.  Thank you!

Capulet is pure magic! Be it for lunch, cocktails or the biggest party of your life!!!!!! They are everything you want in a vendor: communicative, flexible, transparent pricing, and are just generally really good people. The space is so special. It feels so much more intimate and personal than most wedding venues even though it comfortable fit our 160+ guests. Our friends and family are still raving about the space & service. The Capulet team worked so hard for us from planning the event (we were living in another state), the day of and even the morning after making sure we made it home with everything we wanted to keep from the decor. Please consider them for your next event (or even just for lunch or a cocktail). You will not be disappointed!

Café Linnea truly is one of my favorite brunch spots in the city. The quality of their food is undeniable. Every time I visit this place, I try something new and fall in love with their food all over again. 

I first visited Café Linnea two years ago for my friend's baby shower. It was a weekend, and we were able to reserve the private dining area for a weekend brunch. Without a group of 6 or more they do not take reservations for brunch. I decided to order a sweet galette, I cannot remember the name but it had figs and honey. It was just as amazing as it sounds. 

The second time I visited Café Linnea was for my moms birthday. Since we couldn't make a reservation we decided to arrive right at opening on a Sunday. Luckily the cafe wasn't busy and we were able to get seated right away. I ordered the Smoked Chicken Pot Pie and my mom ordered Linnea Benny. My mom said that it was the best eggs benedict that shes ever had! For the chicken pot pie, I added an egg to it. Which was a great addition. The smoked chicken and the creaminess of the bechamel sauce was incredible. 

Cafe Linnea never disappoints! I am looking forward to trying their Oeufs-en-Cocotte next time I visit.

This is a great place for vegans and vegetarians in New Orleans. The menu is interesting and the food tastes fresh and flavorful. The ambience is family friendly - our 9 year old son enjoyed the books in the library and the wild life movie being played on a big screen. Service is prompt and attentive. We ended up going here twice during our 5 day visit to New Orleans - the experience during our second visit was as good as the first!

I enjoy shopping at this market. It is crowded at the usual times, snow storms, holidays, weekends etc. It would be better if they had more cashiers. I find myself using the self checkout a lot, but  I cannot stand  the dirty glass in the seafood department. I would really like to "see"the food. They need to do better.
Beautiful space, great service, well curated drink and food menu, and I love the fried chicken.

Always a great meal from Asian Cuisine! Great service and food is made fresh and fast! Generous portions that are always piping hot! Delivery service is super convenient and ordering online is a breeze.

Wow!  Great burger. Really tasty and juicy and, yes, delicious. 
Lots of other stuff to try here. 
Fries okay. Will try the O rings next time. 
Great that it's not been discovered by the tourists. Yet.

The BEST pizza I have had since I moved here. Their NYC style  pizza witH imported Italian ingredients is amazing. Every time my husband and I order we get two because our family eats the entire fist one and we want to have some the next  day. I just can't believe that crap from IMOS is the "STL" style pizza. I would rather starve then eels that ever again. Pie guys pizza is going to be in our eating out rotation. I think it is also great that this place is connected to a beer bar that has so many  amazing choices too!!! Thank you Pie guys for marking such a damn delicious pizza.

Looking for perfect fried chicken. Ok you found it! Everything I tasted was delicious. My husband was on the fence about ordering grilled cheese, and our waiter suggested that he add chicken breast to it, omg, heck yes, it was so yummy. It had green apple and apricot spread and the kick from the pepper in the fried chicken breast was a perfect addition. Mac and cheese, yum. Biscuits, yum. Fried chicken, yummy and super juicy. It has a slight spicy kick due to heavy black pepper, but they serve it with a side of some honey sauce.... Yes, just yes! Great bear selection. The blackberry lemonade cocktail was the .

The only thing I Did Not like was the seating. You sit so close to ppl that it's a little uncomfortable. They get 2 small tables set them together in one booth and consider it a space for 2 separate parties. That was a not my favorite. :-/

So freaking good! Not only were they knowledgeable about service dogs and our rights (everywhere else was a nightmare) the food was amazing! I had to have toast, because hey, they named the place Toast! I tried the mushroom, bacon and caramelized onion. Every bite was perfect! My husband had the omelette and said it was yummy! We always find the best place on our last day in a city, dang it! Go here!!

Don't order ahead, there's no priority. Waited 35 minutes while they tried to figure out my order, while myriad people ordered and got their food. Place has gone downhill. Real shame because the food is good, but no sense of customer service or management.

The food here was great! I had the blackened shrimp pasta and my friends had the platter and shrimp and grits. We sat at the bar and had a great conversation with James. They also have fresh oysters!!! I only took away one star because the bartender struggled a bit. It was 1 pm in a Friday and not very busy and he messed up simple drink orders which is forgiveable but his attitude left a lot to be desired. Otherwise, a pleasant and engaging place!

We were here a few times last year and it was always pretty decent for breakfast.  This morning the toast was cold and the butter they applied to it wouldn't even melt.  The hash browns were very greasy and tasted as if they were cooked in lard.  However, the worst part of it was that some male was sitting at a table in the dining room just outside the kitchen.  He had at least 5 other men nearby and they were talking (yelling) very loudly.  We were at the very back of the room and the only way we could talk and listen to each other was to lean towards the middle of the table.  In a pinch I would try them for lunch, but never go back for breakfast.

Ordered delivery. Came fresh and hot! Made my own deep dish pizza with paneer, butter chicken, and tikka sauce. Also ordered garlic Parmesan wings. Everything was super flavorful! I absolutely loved it! Definitely should try it if you want doughy pizza and want Indian food!

If you haven't had the pleasure of enjoying midtown eats, boy are you missing out!  The place is so hip!  I've been trying to get my hubby to replicate their cocktail bottle lights for years!  
The food is sooo good!  I literally crave their cauliflower app and the atomic burger with sweet potato fries!  Your mouth will be on fire so you'll need the perfect Margarita to cool you down!
Service is great!  Go!  You'll be back!  I promise it's that good
Great service, great food, beachy vibe, reasonable prices for a gastro pub. Nice selection of craft beer.

This is my favorite Vegan restaurant ever. I highly recommend if your looking for a Vegan restaurant that makes authentic food right there on the premise. Go check them out! Service is excellent as well. I wish I lived closer, i would never cook. Keep up the great work P S & Co....

Brought a friend to this place for her first time. I suggested Beiler's, because they are some of Philly's best doughnuts in my opinion. The line was a bit long as usual, but the employees are efficient, and it moves fast. 

We ordered a half dozen doughnuts and chose various flavor varieties. The half dozen included 'Maple Walnut,' 'Nutella Cream,' 'Fruity Pebbles,' 'Glazed,' 'Boston Cream,' and 'Cookies and Cream.' The dough of all of the doughnuts was EXTREMELY fresh, and they were delicious. However, I would like to point out that these do not sit well due to how fresh they are, meaning that I would buy as many as you'll eat in 1.5-2 days.

If you're in Philly at all, pay this place a visit for sure. These are some of the most delicious and fresh doughnuts in Philly.

This food is phenomenal. Walk past the other restaurants on 7th, and stroll a little further down. You will not regret it. We had chicken, Mac and cheese, wings, potato salad, and peach cobbler. Every single thing was great. To make it even more enticing, the workers are fun, friendly, and efficient.

Favorite underrated hole in the wall St. Louis diner. Burgers and fries are amazing and fresh and I love the milkshakes. The best part is the prices and fast service. A great "old school" no-frills diner that you have to check out.

Olivia is one of the best restaurants in Tampa. I have been here 3 times now and I've become quickly obsessed. I have celiac disease and I love how the staff is very informative and educated on this. The ragu Bolognese is absolutely to die for. I legit have dreams about this pasta, it's that good. The gluten free pasta is absolutely amazing. This is one of the only restaurants where the pasta doesn't fall apart in the bowl. The service is impeccable, the decor is stunning. Overall this is seriously one of the best restaurants. Make a reservation and try this place!

This place has gone downhill. Started as a good place, buffet/a la carte, but of late, with this new management and the experience we had recently with one of the staff ( if you want to be rude...dont work in the hospitality industry).  We have been going here for over a decade....not anymore
Super nice people & very clean facility.  Always great food & easy to get in & out.

Very delicious with a nice ambiance. I came here to get some homework done and got a Southwest Salad. An excellent place to sit with friends or work. 

The portions were decent - considering I got a small - with the price ending around $8 (a little pricey but worth it). 

The workers are also sweet, and the cafe is clean and well-kept. I recommend if you are able to spend the extra money.

You can't really mess up chicken and waffles.  It was delicious.  The bacon and egg were perfectly cooked.  Overall it was a super filling meal.  It's served all day, so no need to worry about breakfast timing.  The service, however, leaves some to be desired.  Staff was seen standing around by the register or the kitchen, and rarely checked on tables.  I try to be flexible when somewhere is busy- but it wasn't really busy at all and you would think I'm an airport, a restaurant would be sensitive to timing.  If you have anything less than a 2 hour layover, I would not recommend this place.

What a nice surprise.  I passed this place many times and stopped in today for the first time.  Such nice people work here! Nice greeting and friendly waitress. Food is yummy basic breakfast fare.  Think big breakfast for under $10.  Clean bathroom and supplied.  Enjoyed  the diner atmosphere.

We loved the food! Mexican Rice is the same as my Grandmother's. So happy not to see the typical red rice. I had carnitas tacos and loved them. My hubby had Arrachera w mushroom sauce and it was delish! The tequila selection was phenomenal. Can't wait to go back!
The worst experience bc of the person taking the orders just ghetto the food was good but the experience was trash

Love this place- found it on yelp looking for a good fish sandwich in south county-
Had a fantastic grouper Reuben! Go there every time my 93 year old dad wants a fish sandwich-
Inside is nice and uses COVID precautions- place was exceptionally clean when we were there!

In Oct 2019, Schakolad Chocolate Factory was sold to the current owner, Jane Rakestraw, & her daughter Darryn Rakestraw-- the store manager. With a background in Business Admin, & w/ her daughter by her side, Jane decided to become a chocolatier. 

The chocolates are made on site. They contain no additives or preservatives. (The Ganaches should be eaten within 3 days-- all others within 3 months.) The chocolates will freeze well if first wrapped in foil. 

This is my second visit to this business-- my first since this chocolate factory sold. The quality, quantity, variety, & taste remain the same-- VERY IMPRESSIVE. The prices are higher now, but that may be due to the toll Covid (& Covid restrictions) placed on businesses. 

The interior is still clean & attractive-- see pics. Service today was professional & VERY friendly. This is one of only a few chocolatiers who offer an impressive line of Sugar-free milk & dark chocolates. I could have saved money by opting for a pre-packaged pound; however, I opted to personalize. My pound totaled $36.75. Expensive, yes, but absolutely DIVINE!

Available are special occassion chocolate gift sets; naughty chocolate designs (you'll have to request to see those:); chocolate gift boxes to hold chocolates; chocolate-covered apples; white chocolate; & chocolate cigars-- to name a few. I also noticed coffee & two chocolate bakery items. There are approximately 70 different small chocolate varieties made here, along w/ 11 Sugar-free offerings--

Very consistent. I know what I'm going to get when I go here. Staff are friendly and portions are good. Food is better than average for Mexican cuisine. Has become a staple for my family since they have opened. Good quick service and the price is right.

Pacific Counter has tons of fun options for customizing a poke bowl (or roll) to remember and crave later, a diverse array of appealing non-alcoholic beverages (plus beer), and a super laid back and friendly vibe.  I'm already eagerly anticipating my return!

I built my own bowl, and I was pleased with "my" creation: Noodles and mixed greens as the base, tuna as the protein, topped with seaweed salad, cucumber, carrot, sunflower sprouts, and mango.  Next time I think I'll add edamame, too.  I went with the counter sauce, which was good, although slightly sweeter than I prefer - I might try fire water next time.  And I really enjoyed the cold hibiscus tea, although beer would have been a good accompaniment, too.  And I'm planning to make sure to enter with a healthy appetite on my next visit, so I'll have room to try a dole whip for dessert!

This cute little spot in the heart of Broad Ripple boasts a cozy back patio and beautiful interior. I had no idea how gorgeous the inside was until we stopped in one day and soaked in the beauty. The walls are dark, the chairs were velvety and comfy, and there were cool decorations everywhere. I love finding cute spots like this! 

We ordered the guacamole, buñuelos (corn fritters), fish tacos (spicy!), papas tacos (fried potatoes) and carne asada taco (my favorite one - not spicy), and sopapillas (similar to fried chips with hot chocolate sauce, honey and whipped cream). The menu was interesting so we wanted to order a few things and all share. Each dish was okay, but I think the cocktails are the shining jewel of it all.

This is definitely a spot I'd love to come back to catch up with friends over cocktails! Because the restaurant/bar is on the smaller side, we were able to catch up and chat without it being too loud, which was super nice. Our server was kind as wel!

So I been passing this place for years and I finally stopped by today. They are busy.  I ordered breakfast sandwich which was cooked perfectly. I ordered over medium on egg and bacon was crispy.  

All employees seemed to be working diligently, no lazy people working at this place. Small family Detroit atmosphere, friendly and very pleased.

Not knowing about their hotdogs special I ordered two chilli dogs to go.
Definitely will be back.
My family has been eating at lamp post for years! Large portions, and fast food is all I could as for and boy do that deliver! Pick-up is always hot and fast. The management is kind, it's a local gem

My boyfriend and I visited Tampa for a short trip and this was the first bar we checked out. Service, drinks, prices and food were great. We even came back before heading home to Orlando. Their covid protocols were safe and clean. Would definitely recommend this bar. Definitely get the beer cheese and pretzels!

So I loved Jasmine Thai when they were on Westshore, but the new location on S. Dale Mabry is Awesome! Besides still serving great food at a reasonable price, they now have a full liquor bar. The staff is always friendly and the food is always good. Can't wait to go back again! :)

I can't believe this is what people will now see as they pull into Tucson from off the freeway. Very disappointed that this land was sold off to another fast food chain. The last thing Tucson needs is more cheap, junk food sold by a corporation whose sole interest is to make money and doesn't do anything positive for the community. I can't believe more tucsonans aren't upset about this. The irony of it all is that it stands directly in front of a beautiful mural that reads TUCSON...

Tuk Tuk Thai Fusion is amazing! Great atmosphere. The staff is very nice and knowledgeable about their foods. And the food is absolutely fantastic! I definitely recommend this place! 5 stars plus all the way!

Honestly I'm so glad we stumbled upon this gem by accident with local Hispanic families eating at the tables outside the restaurant. It's family run which I loved and you know you're giving back to the community and supporting local by eating here. We tried the al pastor, lengua, campechanos tacos. One order comes with 3 tacos, limes, and radishes. We also got the horchata which tasted EXACTLY how horchata should taste. Group favorite was the juicy al pastor as heck and loaded with meat. They do not skimp on your tacos here. It's loaded! Still thinking about it! And in case you need a history lesson about the al pastor, google it lol. The lengua (beef tongue) was so tender and juicy. Haven't had a good no frills tender lengua taco in so long and on the east coast. It was so good! It was our first time trying the campechanos which was a mix of chorizo and carne asada. If you want a meat lovers version of a taco, she's it. Bottom line awesome experience and I'd come and eat here again to try their Mole and fajitas which you could literally smell across the street. I know everyone and their mom is at south philly barbacoa esp since ugly delicious but if you want other flavors of authenticity where the local families eat, walk yourself across the street!

One of my favorite things about Hotel Zamora is the location. It's on the bay side (great for a sunrise), but is across the street from beach access. I stayed here 3 nights using a Travelzoo discount voucher (which gave me nearly half off my stay and made it VERY worthwhile). If you want to see a room tour, I've made this quick video: https://youtu.be/0XdJeszVhZg

The things I LOVED about Hotel Zamora:
*The LOCATION. It's also just 15 mins from downtown and 15 mins to Fort De Soto beach
*It's nice there is a pool that is half covered (shade) and it has a bar with some food items. It's not the biggest pool, but it's nice to have access to hangout there
*Option to ride bikes, rent kayaks from them

What could have BEEN BETTER:
*It's not a place to dine at the restaurant (bad reviews) or hang out in the hotel lobby (very small)
*The rooftop looks AWESOME, but it currently has very limited hours and is only open weather permitting, so I never got a chance to go
*Rooms are comfortable, but dated. I wouldn't call them modern and new, but they are comfortable and adequate
*It's valet parking ONLY which means if you were constantly in and out like I was.. bring a wholllllle lotta dolla dolla bills ya'll
*Service was hit or miss, but Luis at the front desk was the best.

Overall? If it's the right price for you, I'd give it a go. At normal prices, I might reconsider and stay elsewhere, but for my stay, it was perfect!

Delicious food with great service. It's BYOB come prepared but there is a liquor store 5 min walk up the street if you forget...like I did lol. Got the fettuccini Alfredo could use some more spices or zest but the penne ala vodka was money.

This is the worst location in franchise history they are dirty and customer service is horrendous. Drove over an hour to this location as I normally go to the upper Darby one and when I tried to pay with my card over the phone like normal they refused and said I had to drive all the way home to get my card and have it in person that they couldn't type it in like all their other locations force you to pay over the phone for no contact during the virus. Major inconveniences for wayyyyyyy worse food than their counterparts in the area. We will never be back to this location again chick fil a would be better!

This was such a great find in Uptown NOLA. The food was great. Everything came to the table fresh and hot. I ordered the Bearcat Breakfast and my husband had the pork chop breakfast. So delicious. The biscuits are a must have!!! Definitely will be back.

It's been a minute (more like ten years!) since my last visit to Cafe Lift. That certainly wasn't intentional! I always enjoyed Cafe Lift but it sort of fell off my radar once I moved to Philly and walking distance options became more desirable. I've been wanting to get back for a while and today was my lucky day! 

Since my last visit, the cafe now takes credit cards as a form of payment (yay!) and they also have wifi, which makes for a great working lunch locale. 

I know that Cafe Lift's sweet options are absolutely delicious, but I was feeling eggs today, and was excited to see a broccoli, bacon and cheddar frittata on special. Our server told us it came with greens, so I ordered a side of potatoes. However, my plate arrived with potatoes, not greens... Folks, I'm half Irish. There are never too many potatoes. I got the side taters boxed up and plan to enjoy them with breakfast at home later this week. 

My frittata was awesome and I had no regrets. My dining companion enjoyed her greens and grains salad as well. We asked for sides of hot sauce which was clearly made in house - delicious. Our server was friendly and kept the coffee and water coming. 

Glad I made it back, and definitely looking forward to returning sooner than later!

This was a pretty good pizza pie. I came with a co-worker and it had nice outside seating and the pizza was flavorful. I will be back. Only thing I didn't like was that the girl making my pizza had her mask under her nose. Droplets can be released from your nose!

My daily breakfast visits to this Panera location are generally disappointing due to one fact.  At 7:00AM there is not one Whole Grain bagel remaining. This occurs about 3 times per week. The fiber presented by this bagel are an important part of my daily diet, but yet there is no concern to have this item available for customers. Voicing a complaint results in a surly response such as:"this is just a job, it's not my fault."
Add to this the idiocy of being handed a pager, the noise level of the bizarre music and increasing influx of homeless and I will be on the search  for yet another her breakfast location!

Got the Family Feast brisket to go with sides of grilled corn on the cob and mac and cheese.  The four of us could not detect much flavor in the beef, not even a smoked flavor, however sadly the sauces were the highlight of the whole meal, rich and well spiced.  Corn on the cob was supposed to be seasoned but again, no hint of flavor or sweetness like a good corn on the cob should have. Garlic toasts were blah and were just dry sliced pieces of buns slathered with something that wasn't easy to identify.  Mac and cheese -- hm ... wondered how much real cheese was in it, but at least it did have a bit of a kick to it.  We were supposed to get 4 cookies with our order but  they left them out.  There's another "grill" not too far from them who is supposed to have good brisket, so that will probably be our next stop.  Won't be returning here.

Out for a rare dine out for a birthday dinner.  One where when we got done we were just meh.
The good, and earning them one extra star was an eggplant appetizer.  Excellent, they served on two plates as we were splitting it, so far so good, as was the service to this point. 
From there not so great.  The bread they served was bland and dry, just low end, seems trite I know, but when you are sitting there with no food and empty drinks as long as we did... 
The service was friendly, but would just dissapear for long periods, leaving the plates from the appetizer for about 15 min, as an example.
The main course did take too long, my rib eye, not the cheapest item, was a real disappointment, a poor cut with a few mouthfuls of grisle, and was overcooked.  Ordered med-rare, but rhe cut did not have uniform thickness, so the thin end was well-done and dry, and the thicker end barely medium-well (a hint of pink), the gorganzola sauce seemed like it was out a pot a few days old?   I think the mushrooms were from a can.
Wife's Ruben, after being highly recommend, was a similar disappointment, the meat was good, but rye bread, unmelted cheese, no slaw or dressing, more meh.
More waiting to clear table, had to go find the server for the bill, I lucky had cash,some could leave.
So nothing was awful, but in this area, I expect better.

Great takeout experience. Ordered online and food was ready in 15 minutes. Also this food is DELICIOUS. We ordered the duck taco as an appetizer (came with two tacos), I had the Khao Soi, and my boo ordered guey tiew gai. He said the chicken in the guey tiew gai is off the chart - it was freshly seared and brought together the whole soup. The khao soi was also great - it's a creamy yellow curry but the spice combination is authentic and delicious. Duck tacos was a perfect app to order with the soup. Would order it again.

We both ordered Level 2 spicy and it hit the place for me, had a little kick to it but nothing overwhelming (I'm a spice enthusiast too - so take this from my perspective). 

Will definitely be coming back!

This is the best barbecue in the mid west by far. The brisket was perfect not overcooked not under cooked cooked just perfectly with love. I fiancé who is a vegan decided not to be vegan this day because it is so tasty, the onion rings are perfect and the sides are great. Great place for lunch dinner anytime.  They're open on Sunday and I would highly suggest a visit anytime you're by Saint Charles.  Staff is fantastic and and help you find what you need and are very friendly.

I absolutely can not believe how much I loved this restaurant. The food was incredible, I had the chicken and waffle breakfast. The cayenne butter was perfect with it! The staff was super warm and welcoming. I will definitely come back to enjoy breakfast here again.
Love this little local spot. Out of this world fried chicken and very unique gumbo. Small but very good vibe and great service.

First time we have been to The Strawberry Hut and we will definitely be back. The regular Cuban and the pork Cubans were fantastic. We also had strawberry shakes that were delicious. Prices are very reasonable and the service was outstanding.

Yummy food and great service. 

We ordered the chicken and scallops and all dishes were yummy.

We stopped here on our last day of being in town for a conference. I was exhausted so I unfortunately only got to try one beer. It was an imperial IPA and it was very good. We cut straight to the chase and got dinner. I chose the Mango habanero chicken and wow was the flavor amazing!!! The only downside is the chicken was thin, hard to cut, and dry inside. Things like that typically don't bother me because I rather know it's fully cooked than have to send it back for being undercooked. 

Overall, I would highly recommend visiting!

Very comfortable and put together establishment! The place seems clean and well taken care of! The bathrooms were kind of gross and too small. The food and drink options were great. I'm not sure why but I ordered the nachos and went home with a pounding headache and was very ill for the rest of the day. Not sure if the ingredients were expired or if the meat was sketchy but I guess I can't enjoy the food here anymore, it was a very uncomfortable experience!

The food is delicious, and we were grateful for the vegetarian/vegan options. The drinks were flavorful but tiny and rather expensive for their size, but we enjoyed them. Atmosphere had very tiny tables in a condensed space, very European and loud, but romantic and dim lights to add to the mood. After we sat down, a couple sat down next to us. The gentleman had a suit & tie on, with a beautiful fancy   Young lady across from him. A man in a white button up came up to them and offered to take their coats. I may not have been in heels nor my boyfriend in a suit, but I had a black coat next to me and no one offered to do so for me. The gentleman in a suit may have had more money and an outward appeal, but we shouldn't be treated any less.

Ok. Super cute when we came in. Me plus 2 others. Soda was flat. Our waitress Victoria took our order 5 minutes after sitting. Took 25 minutes for a cold sandwich, wrap, and a burger. Mind you the place isn't busy. At all. 2 tables that sat while we were waiting for our food got theirs right after we did. The waitress sucked. Very piss poor attitude. I'm a server myself and I would hate working with her. Don't go here. It sucks. Wouldn't give this 1 star but it won't let me post without it

Came here for the first time about two weeks ago, it was amazingggg!!! The tables inside are very spaced out so social distancing is super super easy. The oysters were literally incredible, my friend and I almost ordered a second plate. The bottomless mimosas are so good (We got the pomegranate kind, so so good), and they give you a great amount in one glass so you're not waiting for it to get filled every 2 minutes. Our server was also the sweetest ever, 10/10 would go again.

Nick-N-Willies has become our go to take and bake pizza joint during this pandemic. Their dough is great and all their toppings are fresh and plentiful. I like the fact that besides having great pizza, the owner always has jobs for local high school students and they're always polite and respectful. The order is always ready on time as well. Definitely a five star pizza joint. In fact I think I'm gonna get a take and bake tonight!  Well maybe tomorrow as I just remembered they're closed on mondays. Bummer!

We went to the Cheesecake Factory in KOP. I've should've known better when the bathrooms were disgusting!!  Now the service, i Ordered a drink and the server looked at my daughter who is under age. I said don't look at her (in a light playful manner) well when she looked at my husband to take his order she had a wide eye look (like a omg). Now the food order Alfredo,  it was runny, asked her if they could fix it, sent it back out dry and with less Alfredo on the plate.  No apology or anything.  Will never go back... HORRIBLE ABD THEY NEED TO CKEAN THE DAMN BATHROOM!!  and too boot no hot water and very little soap.   Again I say HORRIBLE.

The BBQ beef banh mi was very good, the meat and veggies were excellent, the bread tasted a tad stale but the sandwich was still great. There was just enough spice with the jalapeño and a bit of sriracha, but definitely not too spicy. Friendly staff, reasonably priced.

The restaurant claims delivery but when I called, it was not available tonight. That was disappointing but I actually didn't mind picking up our dinner. When I got home the order was wrong which was also disappointing but it was not worth driving back to the restaurant to replace the incorrect item. I simply called to let them know the order was wrong and was put on hold twice but no one ever came on to discuss ( I let the person who answered know why I was calling). That is the main reason why I am taking the time to write this review. The food was ok, not great, but I would expect better service and quality from an establishment that claims 30 years in business.

Even during Covid, this restaurant amazed me. I am road tripping through Nashville and needed to stop for lunch. Saw this place online and decided to give it a shot. I am writing this review to tell everyone how delicious this place is. Waitress was friendly and provided me with personal recommendations, and told me to get the steak sand. I took a photo of it because I was already impressed with the display. Best sandwich of my life. I don't write reviews unless i'm angry and this is the first place that got me a write a review due to its overall greatness.

The ordering experience online was easy to use but once I got to the restaurant I waited 15min before my food was ready, even though the site stated my food was ready for pickup. There were no issues with the food, as I feel Cracker Barrel all tastes the same (not a bad thing). However, I could have ordered my food when I arrived for the amount of time I had to wait for it.

I came in wanting to love this bagel shop, and wanting some of the negative reviews to be wrong. The area definitely needs a great place to grab bagels, and I had high hopes. When I arrived to the shop, I was greeted and placed my ordered very quickly. I had just ordered 6 bagels sliced. After placing my order I stood off to the side waiting for it to be done. 5 minutes later it was announced the bagels were going in the oven and would be done within 6 minutes. The longer I waited, the more impatient customers ahead of me were getting. 15 minutes into waiting I offered to just get a different type of bagel to make it easier on them, and was told that they would then have to bake those bagels as well so I was best just waiting for my original order. After waiting for around 30 minutes total my bagels came out. They were warm and delicious. I believe the shop just has some business processing to fix and they will make for a great staple in the area. The shop just seemed not to take inventory of what was selling quickest and was not looking at what needed to be done. I think hiring someone with a new business point of view, or the ability to manage inventory as it is selling, would do this place well. All in all, bagels were great. My advice: order the bagels ahead of time and pick them up. This will help avoid the mess of waiting in the store for awhile.
Got the chicken ramen and it was average.. broth tasted like water. The noodles were good.

This is the cutest little place! As I always do, I was deciding where to go based on Yelp reviews. 
I was torn between the Fish Tacos or the Drunken Shrimp. 
I went with the Drunken Shrimp. OH. MY. GOODNESS! 
One of the most delicious things I've had. I'd say it's a must if your going to eat here. 
One of my daughters had the clam chowder and Key Lime Tart - she enjoyed both, my other daughter had a grilled cheese sandwich and was happy with that!
Good food and interesting variety. We ordered caprese, Kobe sliders,meatballs, and ahi nachos and all were great

Update: not sure why I gave it three stars to begin with. Food is very good and consistent. Still fast service. Again, I highly recommend the margaritas! Staff is always friendly. 

Mango margarita is delicious!!
Awesome grocery store with you know, food & stuff. I would visit more often if I repaired that starter on my car. It's a bit far to walk here from beach apt.

What a great little find. The wait staff was very friendly and also very laid-back. The menu is seasonal, however I staple on the menu is their burger, a must have! Their beer is also solid if you are into farmhouse ales. They do not offer flights which was a bummer.

Local Gem! Delicious, fresh food and high quality market with incredibly friendly owners and employees. Great place. Love to buy frozen pastas and sauces here for a quick easy dinner at home. Love their takeout. Love the interesting pastas they sell and the desserts are fresh and delicious!

It was just OK. Nothing really bad to say about the place and would have likely enjoyed it more if I had not been to another ramen place that was simply amazing and is only a few blocks away (can't remember the exact name but a think it had Annie in the name). I will not return (not due to a bad experience), just because the flavor of the food at the other place was 3x better and I'd drive to St. Pete just for that experience. My wife agreed with my assessment.

This place was great. By far the best hotdog place in town. We got the Ruby, the Bonnie, the chilli cheese fries and the Capone. The Ruby is really really good if you dig sauerkraut. The Bonnie and Capone were really good too. The hotdogs and sausages are really full of flavor and savory. My only complaint is the chili. Not all that flavorful, but everything else is awesome. If you want a bombass dog, definitely choose this place.

Love Bab my favorite place for a good teriyaki style bowl. My go to is the top Bab with steak and chicken added. Make sure to mix the spicy mayo and teriyaki for the Ukraine sauce. The pop stickers are amazing also. Also get an extra order you will want it. Very quick with the order, tastes super fresh and is nicely packaged. Highly recommend Bab.

Best coffee bar & it attracts folks of all ages to enjoy a good cup of espresso & perhaps something to eat either solo or with friends. I have been buying coffee here since the opening opening day. The owner runs a well managed business & gives back to customers by having one day a year with very reduced prices to say "thank you" for buying your coffee here. This business also contributes to the community in various ways.

Great place to change things up from the country scene and enjoy some great food and and even greater beer. 
Been here multiple times in the past and would return again .

Definitely old-school, this. Although some reviews might say they have only one pizza, which is literally true (a basic tomato sauce and cheese pie), there are numerous items you can add. The small pizza was actually, for us, more than two servings, so we had leftovers. (But this is not your "gourmet" hipster pizza served at so many places these days - and that, quite frankly, I prefer.) We were seated in a booth back in a corner, so the quiet was welcome. The bar is impressively substantial. We tried a few of their red wines, which were good; you don't come to Pica's looking a for a fine wine selection. The take-out counter - perhaps where they do most of their business - looked to be highly popular, doing a ferocious business. The take-out container was plastic, but marked as recyclable (see photo), and they do use plastic bags (takeout pizza boxes looked to be the usual cardboard, not that they can be recycled once they're soiled). This should be an issue for everyone, I leave it to you to judge for yourself how they handle that.
this is my best italian pizzeria il love the food and owners... fair price and good quality and clean place

I had a long review drawn up and forgot to post it lol. 
This place was amazing in every way. Coming from NYC, I can say it ranks up there with the best of them.  Service was phenomenal, the food blew us away. Couldn't have a higher recommendation!!

Finally had the opportunity to go to toast. Got on the waitlist from Yelp(what a great app!) and still had a few minutes before we were able to be seated so we walked through the neighborhood. Beautiful. Asked to be seated inside because was a little chilly. When we got the text to come back. Our seat was at the bar. I Hate Eating At The Bar!!!! I wish the hostess would have specified before hand. I guess I didn't control my facial expression. I have a problem with that. She quickly found us a table to eat our brunch. 
Had the Prosciutto and Brie crepe. Delicious.  Comes with your choose of fruit or salad as a side. Add on a yummy cheese biscuit and you have a perfect meal. Don't forget the house made strawberry jam. Prices were fair. We brought a piece of king cake home. They make it in house. 
The staff was friendly. Had to wait a bit for our coffee refills. 
The place is small seating is limited inside. Several tables outside but a little chilly today. 
Might be our new go to for breakfast

This place is amazing. I am all for the personal size pizza with any toppings for about $8! I tried it for the first time today (Tuesday) and this place is definitely worth the hype. 
I was impressed with the quality of the pizza for a make-it-your-own on the spot. The ingredients were really fresh. I ordered a Mod size pizza, with red sauce, minced garlic, spinach, mozzarella, mushrooms, olives, tomatoes and mild sausage. I usually don't eat the crust of pizzas but I loved the crust on this pizza.
My boyfriend was also impressed. He ordered a Mod size pizza, with white sauce, minced garlic, spinach, mozzarella, blue cheese, bacon, spicy sausage, olives, mushrooms and garlic cloves. 
It was cool to see them put your pizza in the oven. The wait time for cooking the pizza wasn't that long. 
We ordered Garlic Bread, which was very garlic-y but I love garlic so that was more than alright with me. It was also the size of the mod pizza so it looked like we ordered 3 pizzas. 
The atmosphere was very pleasing. The decorations and the vibe are very laid back. And I like how you can sit outside. The employees were very kind and made sure we got what we wanted on the pizza. 
I'll be coming here more often!
